name: Maggi spicy
ingredients_raw: Noodles: Refined wheat flour (Maida), Palm oil, Wheat gluten, Iodized salt, Thickeners (508 & 412), Acidity regulators (501(i) & 500(i)) and Humectant (451(i)). Masala TASTEMAKER: Sugar, Thickeners (508 & 412), Starch, Milk solids, Iodized salt, Cheese (5.6%), Flavour enhancer (635), Garlic powder, Yeast extract powder, Nature identical flavouring substances, Onion powder, Spice extract blend, Maltodextrin, Capsicum extract, Black pepper bits, Dehydrated coriander leaves, Palm oil, Red chilli flakes (1%) and Rosemary extract. Allergen Note: Contains Wheat & Milk. May Contain Soy & Oats.
